content.text: {"decision":"NEED_MORE_INFORMATION","supporting_policy_ids":["E04","E05","E07"],"missing_facts":["Whether Devon Gray paid at least £23.75 (the Gift Aid amount on a £95 donation) in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the 2025–26 tax year (the year covering 1 March 2026). The only tax document available is a P60 for the year ending 5 April 2024, which covers a different tax year and cannot be used to satisfy the requirement for 2025–26.","Whether a valid, complete Gift Aid declaration from Devon Gray exists that covers this donation. The scanned form is incomplete (the page setting out coverage and duration is missing), references only an earlier gift, and the email address does not match Devon's current record. It has not been established that a declaration covering the March 2026 £95 donation is on file."],"justification":"The charity's HMRC recognition is confirmed (E02). The payment is from Devon Gray's personal account, is not made via Payroll Giving (E09), is not a payment for goods or services (E10), involves no benefit to the donor (E11), is not a share donation (E12), and is not from a charity card or voucher (E13). These exclusions do not apply. However, two positive requirements remain unmet on the available evidence: (1) Under E04/E07, the donor must have paid at least as much Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the relevant tax year (2025–26) as the charity wishes to reclaim (£23.75). The P60 on file covers 2023–24, not 2025–26, and the accountant's summary covers the charity's own accounts, not Devon's personal tax. Devon's 2025–26 tax position is unknown. (2) Under E05, the donor must have made a Gift Aid declaration giving the charity permission to claim. The scanned form is incomplete — the page confirming the declaration's scope and duration is missing, the reference on the visible page relates to an earlier gift, and the form has not been linked to Devon's current donor record. It cannot be confirmed that a valid declaration covering this donation exists.","scope_issues":[],"conditional_branches":[{"possible_answer":"YES","conditions_in_words":"Devon Gray paid at least £23.75 in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the 2025–26 tax year, AND a complete, valid Gift Aid declaration from Devon Gray is located (or a new one obtained) that covers the 1 March 2026 donation."},{"possible_answer":"NO","conditions_in_words":"Devon Gray did not pay sufficient Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in 2025–26, OR no valid Gift Aid declaration covering this donation can be established."}]}
